author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Jessica Pegula reached the U.S. Open semifinals for a third consecutive year after rallying from a set down to defeat fellow American Emma Navarro.

Pegula won 3-6, 6-4, 6-3 Tuesday at Arthur Ashe Stadium. The 32-year-old recovered from an error-filled opening set, improved enough to level the match and used an extra service break to control the deciding set.

The victory was Pegula’s fifth in a row over Navarro, including their meeting at the Cincinnati Open last month. It also marked Pegula’s 50th win of the season, making her the first player on the women’s tour to reach that total in 2026.

Pegula will next face two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka in a rematch of the 2024 U.S. Open final. Reaching the final would require Pegula to reverse that previous result against the world’s top-ranked player. Match timing and later tournament details remain subject to the official U.S. Open schedule.
dek: Pegula rallied past Emma Navarro in three sets to earn a semifinal rematch with two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka.
headline: Jessica Pegula reaches third straight U.S. Open semifinal
